limits: Two distinct fixed-seed timestamps are evidence of per-aircraft observed draws, not statistical independence or a population timing law.
PROB=0 prevents the modeled attrition consequence, so no positive damage consequence, item damage, repair or attrition behavior is proved.
Intermediate DAMP, other formation sizes, continuous missions, GUI visual behavior and cross-engine parity remain untested.
scope: One fixed seed, one two-aircraft fixed mission, DAMP=1, and zero-probability attrition consequence. The native log shows one BATTLE-HIT on each aircraft at distinct in-flight times, with one successful formation sortie and two ready aircraft at horizon; SystemResults.NDAM counts both events.
